## Frequently asked questions

### Where is S2V Fitness Centre?
S. No 35/6, Plot No F1, R.G. Nagar, Vengaivasal, Medavakkam, Chennai 600 073 (Open Monday to Sunday, 5:30 AM – 9:00 PM).

### What facilities does S2V Fitness Centre have?
Cardio training, Strength training, CrossFit training, Weight loss, Personal training, Physio & diet counselling, Steam bath, Detox massage, Unisex gym, Flexible hours.

### What are the gym timings?
Monday to Sunday, 5:30 AM to 9:00 PM. Hours may vary on holidays.

### Is S2V for men and women?
Yes. S2V is a unisex gym, with personal training, weight loss programmes and physio and diet counselling.

### How do I join S2V Fitness Centre?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 81221 81823.
